title: Strategic winner lookup: live-record-first by target (continue, resume, supersede, gate), class-strict kind identity
summary: Lookup takes the current project of the kind, else the newest live record; matching target continues, resumes or makes current (orphan beside another current goes through the switch check); different target supersedes only on a won switch; no live record goes through the capacity gate. Divergence 2.143, STRAT-289, Bible ch04. Paired and traced; STOPs disclosed.
